title: CSV Upload Success with Valid Data
description: Verify that CSV file upload processes correctly with valid data mapping and no validation errors.

steps.description: Navigate to the CSV upload screen
Select a CSV file containing valid betting data with correct fields
Map CSV fields correctly if prompted
Submit the CSV upload
Verify the system imports at least 95% of the records without manual corrections
Verify no validation errors or warnings are shown
Verify imported bets appear in the listing interface

title: CSV Upload Failure with Invalid Format
description: Verify CSV upload fails gracefully and shows comprehensive errors when the CSV file is corrupted or incorrectly formatted.

steps.description: Navigate to the CSV upload screen
Upload a malformed or corrupted CSV file
Attempt to map fields if prompted
Submit the CSV upload
Verify the system shows clear validation errors referencing file format issues
Verify no bets are imported and user is prompted to fix the file

title: CSV Upload with Partial Invalid Rows
description: Verify system imports valid rows while reporting errors on invalid entries in a partially invalid CSV upload.

steps.description: Upload a CSV file containing both valid and invalid bet records
Map fields correctly
Submit the CSV upload
Verify valid rows are imported correctly
Verify invalid rows are logged with descriptive error messages
Verify user receives a notification summarizing import with failure counts

title: Listing Interface Filtering, Sorting and Pagination
description: Verify the bets listing supports advanced filtering, sorting by columns and pagination controls.

steps.description: Navigate to the bets list screen
Apply multiple filters such as date range, betting house, and status
Verify the listing updates to reflect applied filters
Sort the listing by ROI and then by date
Verify the ordering of the results on each sorting operation
Use pagination to navigate to next and previous pages
Verify the correct records load on each page

title: Dashboard Metrics Accuracy
description: Verify that the dashboard metrics (ROI, win rate, profit/loss) match historical data and update accurately on filter changes.

steps.description: Navigate to the dashboard page
Verify displayed metrics match pre-calculated historical data for given period
Change date range and tipster filters
Verify dashboard metrics update correctly according to filters
Select different betting houses and verify metrics update accordingly
Confirm no discrepancies in the aggregated data or calculation errors

title: Detailed Bet Modal Display
description: Verify detailed modal displays individual bet details including ticket history and attachments accurately.

steps.description: Click on an individual bet entry in the listing interface
Verify a modal opens displaying detailed bet information
Verify ticket history is displayed correctly with timestamps
Verify attachments (such as images or PDFs) related to the bet are accessible
Close the modal
Verify the modal closes without side effects

title: Report Export Functionality
description: Verify exporting filtered bet data to CSV, XLSX, and PDF formats produces correctly formatted and filtered reports.

steps.description: Apply filters on the bets list to narrow down results
Initiate export selecting CSV format
Verify the downloaded CSV file contains all filtered records and correct headers
Repeat export for XLSX format
Verify the downloaded XLSX file has correct structure, data and formatting
Repeat export for PDF format
Verify PDF is generated correctly with readable tables and correct data matching filters

title: Role-based Authentication and Authorization
description: Verify user access controls restrict actions and views based on user roles (analyst, manager, admin).

steps.description: Log in as an analyst
Verify access only to CSV upload, bet list, and analysis dashboards
Verify analyst cannot access admin configuration or import logs
Log in as a manager
Verify access to dashboards and analysis with advanced metrics
Verify managers cannot access API integration configuration
Log in as an admin
Verify access to all features including API integration setup and system logs

title: API Integration Configuration and Monitoring
description: Verify admin can configure automatic API integration settings and monitor import job statuses and logs.

steps.description: Log in as admin
Navigate to API integration configuration page
Add a new API integration with valid endpoint and credentials
Verify integration saves and is listed correctly
Trigger a manual import job or wait for scheduled import
Verify import job status logs display success or failure information
Access detailed import log for failures
Verify failure notifications and error details are accessible

title: Security: Token Handling and Protected Routing
description: Validate secure authentication token handling and protected access to dashboard and sensitive routes.

steps.description: Perform login with valid credentials and obtain authentication token
Verify token is stored securely (e.g., HTTPOnly cookies or secure storage)
Attempt accessing dashboard pages without authentication
Verify unauthorized users are redirected to login page
Access protected routes after login
Verify pages load and token refresh mechanisms work without errors
Perform logout
Verify token is removed and protected routes become inaccessible

title: Error Handling in Bet Form Submission
description: Verify form validations and error messages when creating or editing bets with invalid or missing inputs.

steps.description: Navigate to create bet form
Submit form with missing mandatory fields
Verify relevant validation error messages are displayed
Submit form with invalid field formats (e.g., invalid odds format)
Verify error messages clearly identify invalid inputs
Correct the inputs and submit successfully
Verify bet record is created or updated correctly without errors

title: Import Logs and Failure Notifications for Administrators
description: Verify detailed import logs are accessible to admins and failure notifications are triggered appropriately.

steps.description: Log in as admin
Access import logs page
Verify logs display detailed records of each import job with timestamps and status
Trigger an import with known invalid data to simulate failure
Verify failure notification is generated and visible to admin
Verify error details are visible and help diagnose import issues

title: UI Responsiveness and Accessibility on Key Screens
description: Verify the user interface is responsive across different screen sizes and meets accessibility standards on core pages like upload, listing, and dashboard.

steps.description: Access CSV upload, bets listing and dashboard pages on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
Verify UI components render correctly and are usable on all screen sizes
Use keyboard navigation and screen reader tools on these pages
Verify focus management, ARIA labels, and semantic HTML ensure accessibility compliance
